blocks.text: Insanon mein (aur tamam mammals aur parindon mein) khoon jism mein do bare raston se daura karta hai. Inhen pulmonary circulation (phephron tak jana aur wahan se wapas aana) aur systemic circulation (jism ke baqi hisson tak jana aur wapas aana) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Beech mein dil. Pulmonary circulation: pulmonary arteries (neeli) khoon ko daen aur baen phephron ke capillary beds tak le jati hain aur right aur left pulmonary veins (surkh) wapas lati hain. Systemic circulation: aorta (surkh) khoon ko oopar baazuon aur sar, aur neeche andaruni aza aur tangon tak le jati hai; superior aur inferior vena cava (neeli) wapas late hain. Teer rukh aur brackets dono circulations dikhate hain.
